name: Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok (ATMB)
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Bangkok, Thailand, over two days: the half marathon on Saturday 28 November 2026 from MBK Center, and the marathon, 10 km and 4.5 km on Sunday 29 November from Sanam Luang.
ai_summary: The Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok (ATMB) is held over two days in Bangkok, Thailand. The half marathon starts at 4am on Saturday 28 November 2026 from MBK Center on Phaya Thai Road; the marathon (2am), 10 km and 4.5 km start on Sunday 29 November in front of the Supreme Court at Sanam Luang. Organised by the Royal Thai Government alongside the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, Royal Thai Police, World Athletics and Thailand Tri-League, and presented by TOYOTA, it offers full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 4.5 km distances. Marathon entry costs 1,400 to 1,800 baht.

core_facts.organizer: Royal Thai Government (Ministry of Tourism and Sports, Sports Authority of Thailand, Tourism Authority of Thailand), Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, Royal Thai Police, Metropolitan Police Bureau, World Athletics, Thailand Tri-League; presented by TOYOTA
core_facts.venue: Sanam Luang (Supreme Court, Ratchadamnoen Nai Road); half marathon from MBK Center, Phaya Thai Road

pros: Night course past Victory Monument, the Rama VIII Bridge, Democracy Monument and the Grand Palace
Seven-hour marathon limit, plus 10 km and 4.5 km races for newer runners
Water stations every 2 to 3 km on the marathon
Fast front of the field: both course records fell in 2025
cons: Very large field: later start blocks were crowded in 2025
Runner complaints in 2025 about toilets, baggage queues and missing finisher shirts
Starts at 2am, with transport and start access to plan carefully
2026 splits the race over two days and moves the marathon start, so the new format is untested

faqs.question: When is the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok (ATMB) held?
faqs.answer: The 2026 race is split over two days. The half marathon is on Saturday 28 November, starting at 4am from MBK Center on Phaya Thai Road. The marathon starts at 2am on Sunday 29 November in front of the Supreme Court at Sanam Luang, followed by the 10 km at 6am and the 4.5 km at 6.45am.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 4.5km race. This range allows both competitive marathoners and casual participants to take part in the same event.

faqs.question: Who organises the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok?
faqs.answer: The race is organised by the Royal Thai Government through the Ministry of Tourism and Sports, Sports Authority of Thailand, and Tourism Authority of Thailand, alongside the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, Royal Thai Police, Metropolitan Police Bureau, World Athletics, and Thailand Tri-League, and is presented by TOYOTA.
